levers.title: compressor-GEMM vs qkv_a skinny priority
levers.reason: needs the qkv_a chain (r3 skinny + RDMA all-gather + l2pf AG fork) on a high-priority non-origin stream inside capture (priority 0 is already the least; aux0 cannot be demoted); RDMA collective never captured off-origin, files not owned; gain depends on undocumented CTA back-fill behaviour; cheap reorder/join variants ~0 (verdicts-r2)

flags.name: DSV41_IDXPAR
flags.meaning: 8 index-source layers (2/8/14/20/24/28/32/36), captured FULL decode graphs only: indexer wq_b -> q rope/quant on an own priority -2 stream, main wq_b -> SWA insert on aux_stream_list[1] (priority 0, host-launched first), kv-source compressor -> wk -> indexer-K store -> compressed insert on an own priority -1 stream; all three joined before logits. 'flat' = same branches, all priority 0 (diagnostic). Unset/0 = stock (helper never imported).

device_checks: boot log on 8/8: 'DSV41_IDXPAR=1 armed: indexer-q stream priority -2, compressor stream priority -1 ...' (if both print the same value the device has one level above 0: lever degrades towards flat); no 'DSV41_IDXPAR: ... stock path' warnings
L2 prefetch capture lines unchanged vs control: 'DSV41_L2_PREFETCH_WOA captured tokens=N ... wq_b=48 (learned 48)' and 'g2 captured ... forks' counts, no MISMATCH
exactness: exact.py ec2f4437f8e1ed09, G1 outputs_digest 2f7fdccbd388225a, the 9 long-prompt hashes (kv-source layers write compressed KV, compressor state and indexer-K caches)
nsys (one rank, 60-step window, --cuda-graph-trace=node): scripts/idxpar_trace.py -> ovl=1, idxS ~0-2 us, prologue sum per forward 383-390 us -> ~240-270 us, woaS >= idxS+idxD
memory: boot KV-cache / free-memory lines vs control (graph pool + up to 2 cuBLAS workspaces)
interacts_with: r1-pf (edits dsv41_l2_prefetch.py: IDXPAR relies on the wq_b post-hook forking WOA from torch.cuda.current_stream(); A/B IDXPAR alone first)
